record_scope_reconstruction: Reuters identifies the Pacaraima international road crossing blocked by residents on 18 August 2018. People also fled on foot; the point cannot imply all foot passage stopped.

source_checks.finding: Reuters body names Pacaraima, describes video evidence of the sole crossing blocked and dates the incident 18 August 2018.

sites.name: Pacaraima–Santa Elena de Uairén

sites.evidence_note: Preserved OSM node 321609940 v5 is a border_control with motorcar and foot access, rather than the town centroid. Reuters identifies the only international crossing at Pacaraima. The 18 August road protest is not the earlier judicial closure.
